case: P04/E04 OpenAI × Chat Completions full and simple options
source: Synthetic offline fixture. Chunk shapes follow OpenAI's streamed Chat Completions (stream_options.include_usage) as consumed by pi-ai 0.87.1 (commit 898ab804050730e9dcefb4443875d5a932aa6a32) packages/ai/src/api/openai-completions.ts through openai-node 6.40.0 (Stream.fromSSEResponse). Expected requests follow pi's buildParams and convertMessages for the standard OpenAI compat; the models are pi's OpenAI data on the openai-completions API (ADR-0013). Costs are pi's calculateCost at the frozen prices of the model used.

scenarios.about: temperature and maxTokens (as max_completion_tokens) go out.
A null temperature is sent as null; maxTokens 0 sends nothing.
A null maxTokens sends nothing.
toolChoice required is sent as is, with the declared tools (strict false: the model's compat supports strict mode).
A named function choice is the function object form.
allowed_tools restricts the model to some functions.
A null toolChoice sends nothing.
A custom model whose compat lacks strict mode declares tools without the strict field.
reasoningEffort on a reasoning model is reasoning_effort, through the level map.
The full entry does not clamp: xhigh, unmapped on gpt-5-mini, goes out as xhigh.
Without an effort, a model whose level map sends off gets it (gpt-5.1: none).
Without an effort, a model whose off is null sends nothing (gpt-5-mini).
A model without reasoning ignores reasoningEffort.
A session id with the default retention sends no prompt cache key off OpenAI's own API (the binding's endpoint is the local provider).
Long retention sends a derived prompt cache key (not the raw session id) and a 24h retention.
Long retention without a session id: the 24h retention alone.
A model whose compat refuses long retention gets neither field.
Retention none sends no cache field.
samplingParams are applied last and override the named fields (OpenAI-compatible semantics).
timeoutMs is announced as openai-node does.
Simple without options: the clamped output budget, nothing else.
A simple level on a reasoning model.
xhigh clamps to gpt-5-mini's highest level, high.
minimal is unsupported on gpt-5.1 and clamps up to low.
gpt-5.2 maps xhigh.
Without a level a reasoning model gets its off value.
The simple tool choice passes through.
The model's samplingParams merge under the call's and override the named fields.
Metadata and thinking budgets have no Chat field.
The simple entry's long retention.
